title: The heat shock transcription factor regulates the expression of crustin in Portunus trituberculatus.
authors: Wu, Yijing; Zhang, Yi; Zheng, Jinbin; Cui, Zhaoxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三疣梭子蟹热激转录因子PtHSF对抗菌肽crustin1表达的调控，通过分子对接模拟揭示DBD与启动子DNA的非共价结合，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且含物理模拟方法，但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或动态机理建模，深度有限。
abstract: Transcription factor is key regulatory component in immune signal transduction. To discover novel transcription factors that modulate antimicrobial peptide expression in crustaceans, we conduct the identification of heat shock transcription factor (HSF) in Portunus trituberculatus and investigated its regulatory role in antimicrobial peptide expression. The PtHSF exhibits typical structural characteristics of the HSF family, including a DNA-binding domain (DBD), hydrophobic repeats (HR-A/B), and a nuclear localization signal (NLS). The PtHSF widely expresses in multiple tissues, with notably high expression in muscle. Although Vibrio alginolyticus challenge does not induce significant changes in PtHSF expression levels in hemocytes of P. trituberculatus within 12 h, PtHSF specifically regulates the expression of Ptcrustin1 in hemocytes. Furthermore, molecular docking simulations reveal that three amino acids (His66, Arg103, and Lys104) in the DBD of PtHSF binds to the promoter sequence of Ptcrustin1 via noncovalent interactions, such as hydrogen bonds and Van der Waals forces. This study enriches the understanding of the regulatory mechanisms underlying antimicrobial peptide expression in crustaceans and provides novel perspectives for disease control in P. trituberculatus aquaculture.
abstract_zh: 转录因子是免疫信号转导中的关键调控组件。为了发现甲壳动物中调节抗菌肽表达的新型转录因子，我们在三疣梭子蟹（Portunus trituberculatus）中进行了热休克转录因子（heat shock transcription factor, HSF）的鉴定，并研究了其在抗菌肽表达中的调控作用。PtHSF表现出HSF家族的典型结构特征，包括DNA结合域（DNA-binding domain, DBD）、疏水重复序列（hydrophobic repeats, HR-A/B）和核定位信号（nuclear localization signal, NLS）。PtHSF在多种组织中广泛表达，其中在肌肉中表达量显著较高。尽管副溶血弧菌（Vibrio alginolyticus）刺激在12小时内未诱导三疣梭子蟹血细胞中PtHSF表达水平的显著变化，但PtHSF特异性地调控血细胞中Ptcrustin1的表达。此外，分子对接模拟揭示，PtHSF的DBD中的三个氨基酸（His66、Arg103和Lys104）通过氢键和范德华力等非共价相互作用与Ptcrustin1的启动子序列结合。本研究丰富了对甲壳动物抗菌肽表达调控机制的理解，并为三疣梭子蟹养殖中的疾病防控提供了新视角。
